newsitem.title: USA: Dow Chemical posts 18 percent drop in profits.
newsitem.headline: Dow Chemical posts 18 percent drop in profits.

text.p: Dow Chemical Co. said Thursday that its profits fell 18 percent in the third quarter as price declines and cost increases offset solid results in its chemicals and plastics businesses.
The company said its net income dropped to $469 million, or $1.92 a share, from $571 million, or $2.15 a share.
Net sales for the quarter rose to $4.99 billion from $4.88 billion on an 11 percent increase in volume and despite a 9 percent decline in prices.
Dow, based in Midland, Mich., said its chemicals unit increased sales to $919 million from $902 million and plastics sales increased 5 percent to $999 million from $952 million.

The Performance Plastics division's sales, however, slipped to $1.3 billion from $1.4 billion as a strong performance in North America for polyurethanes was partially offset by lower prices and volume in Europe.
Dow said sales of its chemicals and metals unit declined to $794 million from $816 million due to higher energy costs and lower prices for caustic soda and vinyl chloride monomer.
The company said its Hydrocarbons and Energy unit boosted sales 23 percent to $646 million from $527 million while the Epoxy Products business posted lower sales.
Dow's stock added 37.5 cents to $78.375 in morning trading on the New York Stock Exchange.
